acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, CG Plumbing Solutions understands that severe grease clogs can cause unexpected and urgent plumbing emergencies, including complete backups or overflows. We offer emergency services to address critical situations promptly, ensuring minimal disruption and damage to your property. Our technicians are equipped to handle urgent clog removals across our service areas, including Las Vegas, North Las Vegas, Henderson, Paradise, and Summerlin. Contact us immediately if you're experiencing a plumbing emergency.
